description.en: The page number of the current page in a paginated query. Default value: **1**.

description.zh: 分页查询时，设置每页包含域名的数量。默认值为**10**。
description.en: The number of domain names on each page in a paginated query. Default value: **10**.

description.zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组。
description.en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not set this parameter, the default resource group is used.

title.zh: 查询所有域名的全量日志开关状态
title.en: Query the full log switch status of all domain names

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于查询所有已接入DDoS高防防护的域名的全量日志开关状态。

### QPS限制

本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This operation is used to query the full log switch status of all domain names that are added to Anti-DDoS Pro for protection.

### QPS limit

The QPS limit on this operation is 10 calls per second per user. If the limit is exceeded, API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. We recommend that you call this operation at a proper frequency.
